title: Relationship Terms Note — Operating Credit and the Equipment & Vehicle Loans Total-Loss Release Premium
content:
**Terms.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans total-loss release premium carries a relationship adjustment from the member's operating credit: 3 points are taken off when the member holds an operating line in active status and none of the member's operating lines carries a late charge dated less than 12 whole months before the release; 2 points are added when the member holds an operating line in active status and one of the member's operating lines carries such a late charge; and nothing changes when the member holds no operating line in active status. The adjustment is made to the product's partial release premium percentage before that percentage is applied once to the unit's share of principal.

## Records it rests on

The member's Operating Lines of Credit: the status of each line, and the late-charge fee entries in the lines' transaction history dated less than 12 whole months before the release.

## Adjustment by combination

| Operating line in active status | Late charge on any of the member's operating lines within 12 whole months | Adjustment (points) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | -3 |
| yes | yes | 2 added |
| no | either | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- A member whose operating lines are all suspended, matured or closed holds no line in active status: no adjustment.
- Hypothetical: on a New Equipment Loan (premium percentage 110) whose member holds an active operating line with no late charge in the 12 months, the percentage is taken at 107 points.
